intro: Choose what the work is for, then the kind of work. A single kind makes one work package; a workflow makes the work packages of its steps for one own party and a period, starts each step when the steps it waits for are approved, and shows where the chain stands.

groups.title: Documents and emails
groups.description: Recognise documents and emails and extract their data.

groups.title: Bank statements and reconciliation
groups.description: Bring in a party's bank statements, or pair their lines with invoices already processed.

groups.title: Quotes
groups.description: Make a quote from a customer's request already processed, priced from your price list.

groups.title: A whole period's work
groups.description: Workflows of several steps for one own party and a period: invoices, statements and their reconciliation, step by step.

documents.title: Documents: extract their data
documents.description: Each document's type is recognised and its data extracted.
documents.cost: Paid: AI within the run's budget.

emails.title: Emails from a mailbox
emails.description: The mailbox's new emails are downloaded; each email's intent is recognised and its PDF attachments are processed as documents.
emails.cost: Paid: AI within the run's budget.

statements.title: Bank statements
statements.description: One party's bank statements for a period: the banks' exports and the statements a reader knows are read by code; any other PDF statement is extracted by AI.
statements.cost: Read by code, free; a PDF extracted by AI is paid.

process.title: A process's case
process.description: A case of a process: it reads the packages of the steps it waits for, or the packages you choose; its page shows its steps.
process.cost: As the process: a paid step waits for a person's start.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation of statements and invoices
reconcile.description: The party's statement lines are paired with its invoices; the result is a summary approved as a version.

quote.title: Quote from a request
quote.description: A quote request already processed (an email with its attachments, or a document) is put together; the quote is made from it and your active price list.
quote.cost: Free to make; the proposal of the quote's lines will call AI within its budget.

templates.title: Documents: extract their data
templates.description: One work package of a folder's documents or of the given files.

templates.title: Emails from a mailbox
templates.description: One work package of a mailbox's new emails and their attachments.

templates.title: Email routing
templates.description: One routing case over email packages already downloaded: their invoices, outgoing invoices and bank statements go to the packages they belong to.

templates.title: From the mailbox to the packages
templates.description: The mailbox's new emails are downloaded and processed with their attachments; once they are approved, the routing proposes the package of each invoice, outgoing invoice and bank statement.

templates.title: Bank statements
templates.description: One work package of a party's bank statements for a period, surveyed before anything is stored.

templates.title: Reconciliation of statements and invoices
templates.description: One reconciliation package of a party and a period, on the invoices and statements already processed.

templates.title: Quote from a request
templates.description: One quote package from a customer's quote request: an email or a document already processed and read as one.

templates.title: Monthly reconciliation
templates.description: The incoming invoices of a folder and the bank statements are processed side by side; once both are approved, the reconciliation package is made for the party and the period.

templates.title: From the mailbox to the reconciliation
templates.description: The mailbox's new emails are downloaded and processed with their attachments, the bank statements side by side; once both are approved, the reconciliation package is made.

templates.title: Monthly reconciliation with invoices from a folder and a mailbox
templates.description: Invoices come from a folder and from a mailbox, the bank statements side by side; once all three are approved, the reconciliation package is made.
